episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Helmus shares his journey to becoming a top 1% producer in the luxury real estate market. He emphasizes the importance of mindset, persistence, and building personal relationships to succeed. Justin also discusses the challenges in the Florida condo market and offers actionable strategies for agents looking to break into luxury real estate.
